proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ f hf
  by_cases hf1 : f = 1
  · simp [hf1]
  · rw [Polynomial.irreducible_of_monic hf hf1]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨hf1, fun g k hg hk e => h g k hg hk e.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, h⟩ g k hg hk e
      exact h g k hg hk e.symm
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] (f : Polynomial A), f.Monic → (Irreducible f ↔ f ≠ 1 ∧ ∀ g h : Polynomial A, g.Monic → h.Monic → f = g * h → g = 1 ∨ h = 1)
